fact: On 26 June 2026 the Government's meeting at the Jefatura de Estado tasked the Ministry of Transport with drawing up a plan to implant a national postal address system covering house numbering and street naming.
title: El Gobierno exige reestructuración inmediata de GETESA ante la crisis de cobertura en el país
